title: [AAPS 3.0.0] Bolus Wizard calculation Settings page BG value shown as x/18 mmol/l.
symptom: When using Bolus Wizard for bolus calculation, the results shown in Treatments tab, and opening the calculation settings via the green 'Calc' link, the BG value on the first line is displayed incorrectly as a value divided by 18 in mmol/l, even though the user uses mmol/l units.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but it is implied that the display issue occurs when using mmol/l units, and it was fixed by a commit in PR #1301.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit in PR #1301 (commit c5d13147f3c8aa91b8d3964878b2cf1b7f21af4d).
